answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can verify identities through a prism of independent checks instead of a single gate: each applicant vertex must complete verifiable work for unrelated verifier lanes, and no one lane can approve it alone. Only when the refracted results agree does the identity climb toward the summit tier where its votes count. Each endorsement costs the endorser a locked stake, slashed if the endorsed identity later cheats, so a farmer creating a hundred fake vertices must buy a hundred work histories and a hundred stake-risking sponsors, while an honest agent pays once.
